WHY: the proxy Worker and its container call the account server from varying Cloudflare egress IPs, so a bound token can never introspect (measured introspect-http-403). HOW: add an 'unbound' option at token creation, allowed only for tokens carrying proxy:exec, shown in the portal token list; the executor token is minted with it. t: (d778be9d) PLAN-prepush-full-cpu PF9: network request widths (xargs -P N fan-out to GitHub, gh api fetch widths) cap concurrent calls to a remote service, not cores  Do fixed network request widths count as the static worker counts the 2026-10-05 ruling forbids? The token is outside rotation-manifest.json. PR-TASK c01fbf97  Widen the enterprise tooling token to R2 and Queues edit? Onboarding creates each company configs/backups R2 bucket and its replication queue (.ci/rediacc_ci/enterprise/onboarding.py buckets()), so without it no enterprise company can be onboarded and V2 region-loss cannot run. DEFAULT: mint a replacement account API token with the current scopes plus Workers R2 Storage Edit and Queues Edit through the Cloudflare API under the Global API Key the rotation tooling already holds, store it in the same Bitwarden entry the enterprise profile binds, revoke the old one, then rerun region-loss --bench. WHY: the code requires it by design; scopes stay account-level as today. HOW: ./run.sh rotation (cloudflare-token platform) or a one-off mint with CF_GLOBAL_API_KEY + CF_EMAIL, never printing the value.  token rotated: new rediacc-cd-20261113T054141Z id 85246113 (old scopes + R2 Storage Write + Queues Write) in bws CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (read-back MATCH); wrangler r2 bucket list and queues list rc 0 under --profile enterprise; old a52f6c90 deleted nocommit:no-tracked-change
